name: brake-cut-holder
note: Ideas 61/71, CMD-08 + F5/ROB-03: the link between the holder and the actuator is cut in both directions in the middle of the braking ramp. A no longer reaches the actuator and no longer hears it, so it deposes itself after the bail timeout (MAN-09) while the actuator revokes on its own miss count (MAN-02/MAN-04). B takes over and the braking must continue; the study measures the deviation to the deceleration setpoint during the whole episode.
